findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions not shown on electrical plan; no dimensions labeled for any of the four pads (e.g., 5'x5', 6'x6', 10'x10'). No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets provided in submittal. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) not specified for any transformer. Provide specific pad dimensions for each transformer and submit proof of Austin Energy Design approval (ESPA or approved pad detail sheets) for the specified service type.

Transformer easements not shown around any of the four transformer pads. Easement width required by Austin Energy for equipment accessibility is not delineated or dimensioned on the electrical plan. Show and dimension transformer easements around each pad per Austin Energy Design accessibility requirements.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations adjacent to buildings with windows, doors, or ventilating ducts
findings.comment: Minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance required from windows, doors, or ventilating ducts on adjacent buildings (for oil-filled equipment only if window/door/duct is less than 12 feet from grade or has less than 5 feet lateral separation). Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on electrical plan. Building elevations showing window and door locations relative to transformer pads are not provided. Lateral separations and vertical clearances not dimensioned. Submit building elevations with windows/doors/ducts clearly marked, transformer equipment specifications, and dimensions showing compliance with clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations if oil-filled equipment is used
findings.comment: Minimum 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes required for oil-filled equipment. Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified on electrical plan. Building elevations showing fire escape or fire exit stair locations relative to transformer pads are not provided. Distances not documented. Submit transformer equipment specifications and building elevations clearly showing fire escape/exit stair locations with dimensions demonstrating compliance with 20-foot clearance requirement.

Minimum 5-foot clearance required from fire hydrants. One private fire hydrant is shown on Sheet 10 (Fire Protection Plan), while transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan). No cross-sheet clearance verification or dimensional documentation provided showing distance from each transformer to the fire hydrant. Provide clearance dimensions from all transformer pads to the fire hydrant location or submit a consolidated plan overlay clearly showing both features with distances marked.

Minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lanes required. Fire lanes are delineated on Sheet 10 (Fire Protection Plan), while transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan). No cross-sheet documentation showing clearance distances from transformer pads to fire lanes. Provide dimensional clearance verification or submit a consolidated plan clearly showing both features with measurements confirming 15-foot separation from all transformers to fire lanes.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations adjacent to water utility lines
findings.comment: Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance required from water lines. Water utility lines (marked 'W') are shown on electrical plan crossing near transformer locations, but clearance dimensions are not provided. No profile or vertical separation details shown for utility crossings. Provide utility plan with profile views showing 5-foot horizontal minimum clearance and appropriate vertical separation (minimum 12 inches per UCM § 1.10.5.A) from all transformer pads to water lines.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations adjacent to wastewater utility lines
findings.comment: Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance required from wastewater lines. Wastewater utility lines are shown on electrical plan but clearance dimensions are not provided. No profile or vertical separation details shown for utility crossings. Provide utility plan with profile views showing 5-foot horizontal minimum clearance and appropriate vertical separation (minimum 12 inches per UCM § 1.10.5.A) from all transformer pads to wastewater lines.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations adjacent to storm drain lines
findings.comment: Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance required from storm drain lines. Storm drain lines and inlets (marked 'SD') are shown on electrical plan near transformer locations, but clearance dimensions are not provided. No profile or vertical separation details shown for utility conflicts. Provide utility plan with profile views showing 5-foot horizontal minimum clearance and appropriate vertical separation (minimum 12 inches per UCM § 1.10.5.A) from all transformer pads to storm drain infrastructure.

Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance required from other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, and steam). Multiple utility lines are shown on electrical plan crossing near transformer locations, but clearance dimensions and profile details are not provided. Provide profile and plan views with clearance dimensions and details showing how underground utilities are separated vertically and horizontally from all transformer pad locations.

applicableAreas: access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas above transformer locations
findings.comment: Cross-section drawings are required showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas. The site plan shows interior courtyard areas above transformer locations where vertical clearance verification is necessary. Cross-section drawings for vertical clearance compliance are not provided. Submit cross-section drawings showing the proposed transformer locations with vertical clearances to overhead structures, building overhangs, or any enclosed access areas.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations if oil-filled equipment is used
findings.comment: Grading and drainage must direct liquid flow away from buildings for oil-filled transformer equipment. Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on electrical plan. Grading plan (Sheet 11) does not specifically indicate surface drainage direction at transformer pad locations. Submit transformer equipment specifications indicating whether oil-filled or dry-type, and provide grading plan annotation with arrows showing drainage direction at all transformer locations confirming flow is directed away from adjacent buildings.

applicableAreas: electrical routing from all four transformer pads to corresponding meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer to meter must be 100% on private property. While electrical routing is shown on Sheet 21, there is no explicit documentation confirming that all routing from each of the four transformers to their corresponding meters is entirely on private property. Provide written documentation or an annotated plan clearly demonstrating that the entire electrical routing path from each transformer to its meter is 100% on private property, not crossing public right-of-way or easements.
